replies.author: Tazz
replies.body: I was never really involved in public Avicus, I just got bored, not even just of Avicus, but generally playing Minecraft in general. I just wanted to start my own projects because there was things I saw OCN and Avicus doing wrong which I thought I could make right and benefit from. So I just kept getting further away from Avicus.
